verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 / DGX B200 is GPU compute hardware with system-management software. In-product AI-generated insights and suggestions about a user's data is an application or analytics feature, which is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself ships such a capability: health monitoring, Mission Control and the ability to run user-built AI workloads are not built-in insight features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
